name: IBY_TRXN_DOCUMENTS
description: This table stores the information for the transaction documents.

columns.name: TRXN_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: PK

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: Payment file identifier

columns.name: TRXNMID
columns.description: Column is a foreign key into table IBY_TRXN_SUMMARIES_ALL .  Indicates which transaction

columns.name: DOCTYPE
columns.description: Column holds an application defined number indicating what type of document this is.

columns.name: DOCUMENT
columns.description: Column holds the actual XML document.

columns.name: FROZEN_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only - reserved for future use

columns.name: TO_BE_PURGED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only - reserved for future use

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used in hosted environments

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PURGED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only - reserved for future use

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PURGED_DATE
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only - reserved for future use

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_FLAG
columns.description: Encrypted flag

columns.name: COMPRESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Compressed flag

columns.name: DOC_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Content type from BIP output, such as text or PDF

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CLOB
columns.description: Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher extract of payment file as Character Large Object (CLOB) data type.

columns.name: MBATCHID
columns.description: A foreign key into the table IBY_BATCHES_ALL. It's an application generated unique batch identifier.
